mark: Each name gets a plate cut on two opposite corners with its own colour as the edge, and the letters are set in the ticker mono. The round mark becomes an octagon, never a circle, and the current mark carries a plain two-colour ring off its edge. Look for the corner glyph: it is the one corner left uncut.
stackbar: The share bar is the machined channel of dark's progress bar: ticked track, cut corners, parts laid left to right by one pass of 660 ms and then still. Pointing at a part, or at its legend row, rests the 2 px line of film at that part's start edge; the threshold is a lit tick, and every reading is in the ticker mono.
bullets: The bars are dark's own meter. A row that is warned or over its threshold turns the film along the figure's edge coral or amber and nothing else: no filled plate. The rows are laid one pass at a time, 60 ms apart, and a hovered link row rests the line at its start.
tick: A changed figure takes the film through its letters in one pass of 660 ms and settles back to ink; it never moves or flares. Look at the figure staying exactly in place while the colour crosses it.
uptime: The strip is laid by one pass from the start. A cell you point at takes the line on its top edge with a small glow; nothing lifts. Percentages, incident counts and the axis are readings in the ticker mono.
uptime-states: Loading is the shared busy card in dark's comet, the line with a film tail crossing the empty slots; an error summary is the film gone coral along its edge, not a red plate. Every state keeps the strip's height.
uptime-phone: At 390 px the strip keeps its cells square and the summary stays on one line; the pass and the line on hover behave exactly as at full width.
inbox: A row's state is a 2 px bar along its start edge: the film for new and next, coral for failed, amber for a warning. Pointing at a row rests the line of film outside that edge; rows are laid one pass at a time, 60 ms apart. Times and meta lines are in the ticker mono.
backlog: The same rows with a payload that opens under the row as a slot with cut corners in the mono. The failed message carries the coral edge; the dead badge and Delete stay dark's own.
files: A file list in dark's rows: the type tag is a mono microlabel, a missing file is the coral edge on its row, and View and the open-in-tab button are dark's bracketed buttons.
appointments: The next appointment takes the film along its start edge and the lead in cyan; past ones go quiet by ink, not by fading. Dates and times are in the ticker mono.
checks: Check rows keep dark's status rows. A warning row is the film gone amber along its whole edge with the fix written under the title behind a 2 px line; a failed one is the same in coral. Nothing is filled.
sort: The sort a page carries out is drawn in dark's own table header, unchanged from the approved table: a column that cannot be sorted now is quiet and gives no pointer. Look that the header keeps its bracketed, ticked look and nothing shifts when the order changes.
kv: Keys are small microlabels, identifiers are mono, and a row with a change carries a cyan mark after its key. A row that could not be read has a coral line along its start edge and the rest of the grid keeps its place.
formrows: Labels sit on one edge with their small print under them, the control in the middle and the aside on the right. A locked row shows its lock, a failed row the coral line along its edge. Nothing in the row is rounded.
tiles: Choices are slots cut on two corners. Pointing at one rests the line at its start edge; a checked tile takes the film along its whole edge on the accent plate. The disabled tile is dashed and quiet.
card-states: A card in four data states: loading is the shared busy card with dark's comet and spinner of spectrum bars, empty is dark's bracketed empty state, failed is the film gone coral with a normal Retry, ready lays its content by one pass. All four fill the same footprint.
header: The page header keeps its title and badge; the freshness line beside it is a small reading in the ticker mono.
art: Dark's set is the spectrum: a screen cut on two corners with a faint grid, a baseline, and the film as the acting stroke. Nothing found shows brackets round nothing; an error shows the line cut in coral; offline is the track broken in two; done is the track laid in full with the bracket closed. Each drawing is laid by one pass, left to right.
pipeline: Lanes are slots with their stage's colour as a film edge on a bracketed mono head. A card rests the line at its start edge when pointed at, the chosen card takes the film along its whole edge, and lanes are laid one pass at a time, 60 ms apart.
pipeline-states: Loading is the busy card in the comet over lanes that keep their place; empty and failed fill the board with a normal-size Retry. At 390 px the lanes stack as rows.
journey: The path between steps reached is a 2 px line of film with its glow; steps to come are a dotted scale. Marks are cut squares, the current one has a ring of film, dates are in the mono.
journey-states: Loading waits as the comet over the path, no dates yet leaves the dotted scale, and the phone layout turns the path to a column with the line down the marks.
contact: Moments sit on the run timeline's lanes as small shapes; pointing at one gives it a soft glow, zones are bands with a drawn start edge, and the +1 count is a cut mono chip.
contact-states: Loading is the busy card with the comet, empty and failed keep the timeline's height with a normal Retry, one lane and the phone width keep the same rules.
secret: The value sits in a slot cut on two corners in the mono. Shown, its edge takes the film, the text is laid by one pass, and the countdown is the film running out along its line; a failure is a coral line along the message.
secret-phone: On a phone the field, its buttons and the countdown stack in the same order and the countdown line keeps the full width.
manage: The wide dialog is swept in where it stands, as dark's dialog always is. Section headings are bracketed mono labels, sections are divided by a hairline with a short film tick at its start, and the danger section has a coral line along its edge.
confirm: The confirmation lists what still depends on the thing in a cut slot; a blocked removal shows no field. The wording stays in Archivo, only names are in the mono.
type-dialog: The name to type is a mono chip underlined with film; the list of what is lost is a slot with a coral line along its edge. When the typed name matches, the input gets a film line under it.
type-own: In the page's own dialog every state keeps one height: empty, partly typed, matching, wrong case, locked. The match line is a mono reading and never moves the buttons.
type-phone: At 390 px the dialog, the list and the input keep their order and widths; the match line stays one line high.
disc: The time left is the film laid round a ticked face as a ring, turning back to twelve o'clock as time goes; the hub is a dark point with a film ring. No ticking numbers.
disc-states: Paused is a dimmer ring, ended puts a coral ring round the face and says so in the mono caption. Every state keeps the face's size and the buttons' place.
disc-phone: At 390 px the disc is capped to the window width; the caption and buttons stay centred under it.
countdown: The digits are the ticker mono in fixed cells so the time never moves the layout, the colon a cyan tick; the name above and the status below are mono readings.
countdown-states: Paused dims the digits, ended turns the status line coral and rings the plate in coral. Each state keeps the same size at 1280 and 390 px.
range: Presets are dark's segmented control; the custom window opens a panel on dark's own opaque plate under its button, with the bound labels as mono microlabels.
range-states: A custom window, a limit, disabled and the phone width: an invalid bound gives a coral line along its message and nothing else changes colour.
wheel: The rim is a hairline of film, segments are quiet tints, the pointer is a cyan tick with a glow, and the spin settles on dark's own settle curve. The outcome is laid by one pass; the labels are mono.
cook: One step at a time: the step is laid by one pass when you move to it, the ingredients are a slot with a film line at its start, and the counter and amounts are in the mono. Loading, failed and empty keep the cook-mode height.
timers: Each timer is a slot cut on two corners with its time in the mono; the progress bar is dark's own ticked channel. A timer that has ended is the coral film along its start edge and a coral state word, the plate staying near-black.
quantity: Minus and plus are dark's bracketed buttons around a cut slot; the number and the unit are mono and the focus ring is dark's two-channel ring.
checklist: A row rests the line at its start edge when pointed at, a ticked item is struck in film colour and sinks, and the head and counts are mono microlabels. Loading, failed and empty keep the list's footprint.
tri: A chip that must be in takes the film along its edge on the accent plate; a chip that must not be in has a coral edge and a struck word. The summary line under the group is a mono reading.
code: The code block is a slot cut on two corners with a film line under its head, the title in brackets and the gutter in the ticker mono. Wrap, copy and the fold keep the head's height.
command: The terminal name is a bracketed mono label over a film line, the prompt is the film's cyan, the where-line a quiet mono; the code is laid by one pass when the page draws it.
command-long: Long commands wrap or scroll inside the same cut slot; a continued line keeps its prompt gap and nothing runs under the copy button.
command-phone: At 390 px the head stays on one line and the copy button keeps its width.
compare: The divider is the line itself, 2 px of film with the one glow dark allows, the grip is a cut octagon, and the labels are bracketed mono microlabels.
compare-live: Loading lays the shared busy card in dark's comet over the images; a failed image shows its words and a normal Retry in a cut slot. The divider and the other pane keep their place.
